description: Creates a request to store a credential at the described destination and opens Lockbox's own authorization window on the user's machine, where the user reviews the destination and types the value. Returns a request id, the normalized destination, a risk classification and the request state — never the credential value, which no Lockbox tool accepts or returns. Does not write anything by itself: the write happens only after the user authorizes it. Use secret_status to follow the request, and secret_revise to change an already-authorized destination.

description.description: Short, non-sensitive purpose shown to the user on the review screen.

destination.description: Destination that will receive the credential: 'custom' with target.definition, or 'saved:<name>' for one the user saved (target then empty).

environment.description: Environment this destination is believed to belong to. Advisory only: Lockbox classifies the destination itself and applies the stricter of the two.

name.description: Logical name of the credential, e.g. STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. A label only: this field must never contain the credential value.

target.description: Where the credential goes. Accepted fields depend on the destination; secret_destinations returns the exact contract for each.

definition.description: Where and how to store the credential: an http request, a local command or a local file, with {{secret}} exactly once where the value goes. Kinds enabled: http, command, file. secret_destinations returns the full contract and examples.

write_mode.description: 'create' fails if a value already exists, 'new-version' adds a version, 'replace' overwrites. Availability depends on the destination.

name: secret_store
title: Request credential storage
